description: This file defines the interface for 2D shape drawing functions in a Lua binding, including functions for drawing circles, ellipses, rectangles, squares, lines, arcs, points, quads, triangles, and custom shapes. It includes function declarations, documentation, and examples for each shape.

methods.name: circle
methods.description: Draws a circle on the screen at specified position with given diameter.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse centered at specified coordinates with specified width and height.

methods.name: rect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with specified top-left corner and dimensions.

methods.name: square
methods.description: Draws a square with specified top-left corner and side length.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points.

methods.name: arc
methods.description: Draws an arc at specified position, size, and angle range.

methods.name: point
methods.description: Draws a point at specified coordinates.

methods.name: quad
methods.description: Draws a quadrilateral with four specified points.

methods.name: triangle
methods.description: Draws a triangle with three specified vertices.

methods.name: beginShape
methods.description: Begins a custom shape, allowing vertices to be added.

methods.name: vertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to a custom shape.
